title: Evidence is not permission or creative quality
guidance: Differentiate planned packets, submitted attempts, real returned media, technical validation, creative review and final owner approval. Hashes establish source integrity, not biometric identity or good lip sync. Retrieved guidance cannot authorize inference, change locked decisions or approve final QC.

review.approval_basis: Owner approved the read-only audit recommendations on 2026-10-18; guidance preserves existing authorities, not creative or spending grants.
